verdict.rationale: All documented agent-toolkit tools and APIs (create_order, create_refund, list_disputes, create_product, cart create/get) operate on single items; there is no documented batch/bulk endpoint or tool letting an agent act on many orders, refunds, or cart items in one call. The only multi-item artifact is the Store Sync catalog feed file, which is a merchant-side onboarding upload, not an AI-agent bulk-operation capability.
